dimensions.title: Cognitive
milestones: Understands the concept of time (morning, afternoon, evening)
Can categorize objects by color or shape
activities: Read storybooks and discuss the plot

dimensions.title: Language
milestones: Can speak in full sentences of 5-6 words
activities: Sing songs and recite nursery rhymes
watchFor: Shows little interest in books or reading

dimensions.title: Physical
milestones: Can throw and catch a ball with some accuracy
Can use scissors to cut simple shapes
activities: Set up obstacle courses for jumping and balancing
Play sports or games involving throwing
Provide coloring books for fine motor practice

dimensions.title: Social
watchFor: Inability to share or take turns

dimensions.title: Emotional
milestones: Can calm down after being upset with guidance
activities: Encourage children to talk about their feelings

dimensions.title: Curiosity
milestones: Shows interest in how things work
watchFor: Lack of interest in exploring new things

dimensions.title: Learning
milestones: Can focus on a task for 10-15 minutes
Can recognize some letters and numbers
activities: Engage in board games that require strategy
Create a learning routine and stick to it
watchFor: Short attention span causing difficulty completing tasks
Avoidance of challenges or new information
Struggles with memorization or retention of concepts

dimensions.title: Independence
milestones: Can dress and undress with minimal assistance
Can follow basic rules or routines
watchFor: Inability to perform simple self-care tasks
Reluctance to try new things independently
Frequent reliance on adults for decisions
